Contactless payment is available on all South East Queensland (SEQ) trains, trams, ferries and buses---you can use your digital or physical bank card to tap on and off. The workshop will be held in the conference room on the ground floor, before the security check point. On-site parking could be arranged. Get in touch with us for options. ## Food and drink #### Lunch There is a cafe on-site (Hey Mr Dutton Park) with several excellent food options. If you would like to eat there, please consider pre-ordering your food upon arrival each morning so we don’t overwhelm the staff at lunch time. There are additional cafes within a 10-minute walking radius. #### Dinner Group dinners will be organised for each night from Monday to Thursday. These dinners are optional and will be pay-your-own-way. We will book restaurants within a 20-minute walking radius from the workshop and confirm numbers each morning. If you have any dietary requirements that you would like to be considered when booking dinner locations, please contact us by 1 August. #### Morning and afternoon tea Tea and coffee will be provided on site. ### Accommodation There are ample accommodation options, either walking distance or accessible via public transport.
